ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.

15. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Care CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Safety CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain : OUR SCHOOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Home ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
